hook: This guy spent *5 billion Opus 5.5 tokens* creating a simple tear
caption:
An 11 second clip shows denim tearing, with single threads fraying as a small hole grows.
The creator, @scottstts, says the simulation took 5 billion tokens on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5.
He also put a browser version online called Break That Denim, where anyone can try tearing the fabric.

Would you spend that many tokens on one tear?

Follow @neurafeed.ai for daily AI news.
